subject: Commercial path & procurement readiness — trial conversion planning
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@finexus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Commercial path & procurement readiness — trial conversion planning

Hi Emma — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps so we have a shared plan for trial -> paid conversion:

Summary of what we demoed:
- API integration for ingestion + generation (auth with API keys)
- Streaming responses and token accounting per request
- Observability: per-route latency/cost dashboards in Redwood Console

Proposed trial success criteria (please confirm or edit):
1) Integration: Redwood SDK call implemented for 2 main services (ingest + scoring) by your dev team
2) Traffic: sustained ~1M tokens/day in test window or equivalent hit-rate mirroring production slice
3) Quality: response latency under 250ms P95 for the canned workload, and output precision >= 85% on your evaluation set
4) Security: minimal items on our standard security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence provided)

Procurement/commercial questions for your team (we want to align early):
- Purchase method: do you prefer a PO (net 30), a corporate card, or billing through a marketplace (AWS Marketplace)?
- If PO: any special terms (billing start date rules, invoicing contact, required PO template)?
- Marketplace: would you prefer this to simplify billing or does internal procurement require a direct PO?

Attachments: Ive attached a short trial success metrics template and a draft SOW so procurement can see scope/charges up front.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm procurement preference + contact (if PO, loop in procurement)
2) We finalize trial start date and target success metrics (I suggested a 2-week window but flexible)
3) Marissa will prepare a compact commercial summary + SOW updates per your feedback

Happy to hop back on a 15-min call to finalize procurement path if that helps.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

Attachments: trial-success-metrics.xlsx, redwood-sow-draft.pdf

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@finexus.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finexus.com>
Date: 2026-03-20T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial path & procurement readiness — trial conversion planning

Thanks Sean — clear recap and useful checklist. A few quick answers from procurement side:

- Procurement preference: PO is our standard for new vendors. We can do net 30. Ive CCd our procurement lead so they can confirm any clause-level items.
- Marketplace: we prefer direct PO for now; marketplace can be a path later but needs internal approvals (not preferred for initial pilots).
- Billing start: procurement typically expects billing to start on the "contract activation" date stated on the PO rather than the first API call. Is that possible?

Weve attached our PO template for your legal team to review (finexus-po-template.pdf). Also, please send a short commercial summary (line-item pricing for trial-to-paid conversion) so procurement can route it quickly.

One more thing: our legal asks whether Redwood can accept standard Finexus data residency notes — I mentioned SOC2 and KMS integrations during the call but will send over any redlines if needed.

If we can get the SOW + commercial summary by EOD Monday (3/22), procurement can aim to turn around the PO the following week.

Best,
Emma Liu
Head of Product, Finexus Analytics
emma.liu@finexus.com

Attachment: finexus-po-template.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@finexus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-20T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial path & procurement readiness — trial conversion planning

Thanks Emma — that timeline works and PO/net30 is fine. A few clarifications and an action plan below: 

Billing start options we can support (pick one):
A) "Contract activation date" on the PO = billing start (procurement-friendly; invoicing aligns with PO)
B) "Start billing on scheduled activation" (e.g., Mar 30) regardless of PO receipt if you want the trial window to map to calendar dates
C) Card or Marketplace charge = immediate activation on payment (fastest path for pilots)

If procurement wants option A, we can accept that and invoice per stated PO activation date. If youd like the trial to operate as a trial (no charges until activation), choose B and we will only start invoicing on that scheduled date.

Commercial summary (high level):
- Trial (2-week): no-charge sandbox with usage visibility; optional paid trial billing if you elect to convert early
- Production reservation (example): 2x g4dn-equivalent reserved capacity — est. $5,400/month (subject to final model/usage mix)
- Overages: billed monthly at standard rate per token beyond committed units

Weve attached an updated redwood-sow-draft.pdf and the trial-success-metrics.xlsx filled with the suggested KPI thresholds from todays call. Marissa, Aditya: please review the pricing note above and confirm whether we can provide a single-line commercial summary for procurement (one-line total for initial 90-day window + optional reserved capacity).

Next steps:
1) Emma: confirm billing-start preference (A or B) and target activation date (if B)
2) Procurement: review SOW + commercial summary; confirm any required PO clauses
3) Well generate a short commercial cover note for your procurement team and return it with the SOW

Happy to schedule a 15-min approval call with procurement if it speeds things up.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sow-draft.pdf, trial-success-metrics.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial path & procurement readiness — internal alignment

Looping in quick internal notes (internal only):
- Approve the pricing ballpark Sean shared. For procurement, Ill prepare a one-line commercial summary for the PO ("90-day initial term: $8,100 total") and call out the reserved capacity option separately.
- We should offer a 10% PLG/early-pilot credit if they sign PO within 10 business days — makes procurement decision easier.
- Ill update the SOW to include the Finexus-specific success metrics and add a "billing start" clause that lets us align to PO activation (option A) or scheduled activation (option B).

I can be on the procurement call Monday (3/23) if needed.

— Marissa
Account Director, Redwood Inference

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@finexus.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finexus.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial path & procurement readiness — trial conversion planning

Hi Sean/Marissa — good progress, thanks. Procurement confirmed they will proceed with a PO (net 30). Procurement contact is Alicia Park (alicia.park@finexus.com) — Alicia is CCd on this message.

Wed like to take option A (billing start = contract activation date on the PO). Target activation date: 2026-03-30. Please update the SOW accordingly and send the one-line commercial summary you mentioned.

Ive attached our completed PO template (finexus-po-template.pdf). Procurement will aim to return a signed PO by 2026-03-27 if we can get the commercial summary + updated SOW today.

Confirmed trial success metrics (final):
- Integration completed end-to-end by 2026-04-06
- 1M tokens/day sustained across the 2-week window or equivalent
- P95 latency < 250ms for the evaluation workload

Were attaching the PO template now. Once we receive the final SOW and commercial summary well circulate internally and push for the 3/27 turnaround.

Best,
Emma Liu
Head of Product, Finexus Analytics

Attachments: finexus-po-template.pdf, finexus-signed-po.pdf
